messages.author: GMDS
messages.text:
How did you find us?

What's is your 95 experience?

You will need to download the retroarch  platform,  and complete your internet port forwarding.  See #tech-channel , and download the game/season rom . See #tech-material . Also familiarize yourself with #online-rules 

Basically, if you start a franchise here is the bullet points

1) create a team name, name of your stadium, colour scheme, and logo

2) you (and another expansion team) will be  able to select players from our free agent list

3) you will be provided a 1st and 2nd rd pick In our end of year draft (end of each round)

4) submit roster and starting line up to our commish/rom creator @UltraMagnus 

5) play the games and have fun

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
- Download Retroarch from here (bottom right depending on your computer): https://nhl94online.com (don't go out and download the latest version, use this one)

- Download the ROM (this is the game) file from here (W18 is your best bet): https://discord.com/channels/146381349589090305/1441778748713209927/1537785377849344111

- Getting Started - the 94 nerds have a pretty good set of instructions you can follow:  https://nhl94online.com/html/getting-started.php

** It's not very difficult at all so don't get overwhelmed if you are not technical in any way....Feel free to ask for help - overall it could be fully setup in under 5 minutes

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Also buy a controller if you don't have that 🙂

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
https://amzn.to/4oNhQ8a  Retrobit Genesis Controller → — cheaper option, works fine, won't last as long as the next option. Suggest buying 2 at a time. Doesn't always require controller configuration.

https://amzn.to/47EvSlv  8bitDo M30 Controller → — more expensive but lasts much longer than Retrobit. Controller configuration is more complicated and usually requires someone to share a picture of the setup. Comes with a wire even though not shown on Amazon, but some use wireless. Note that newer versions of 8bitDo may not work — multiple cases reported.

messages.author: krav1
messages.text:
Hi all…I agree with @red 
The beauty of this league is that the less skilled players (on the controller) are able to build more skilled teams.  In theory this is supposed to level out the game play and give the league some parody.  So if the same bottom teams end up with the higher draft picks then eventually they will have to drop them to add another stud and that’s why I proposed (hopefully implemented) snake draft where the top players will be able to draft these players at the beginning of the 2nd RD.  

The middle class always gets the shaft (it’s the way it is).  Middle 3rd of the league doesn’t get a great 1st round pick and probably won’t benefit from grabbing a decent dropped player.  So this is where you need to improve your GM skills and get more savvy.  Maybe you can intercept and trade for one of these players that a bottom team may have to drop to make room for their pick etc….I get it everyone wants a chance to get a unicorn which is the e main reason for “The Tank”

So I have a thought on maybe curbing this urge…Don’t do It!  Hahaha…

messages.author: krav1
messages.text:
I like Nate’s idea and I’m game with trying it but don’t think most of the league agrees.  So here is a draft order proposal (lottery).  This is based on the current 29 teams (16 playoff teams and 13 non-playoff teams).  
Top 5 picks will consist of 4 non-playoff teams and 1 playoff team.  The winner of the Shitty Bill is guaranteed to be in the top 5.  Each of these teams will have an equal chance to get the number 1 pick.  
How these 5 chosen teams are selected….

Playoff team lottery…seeds 13-16 (10% chance)…9-12 (7.5% chance)….5-8(5% chance)…1-4 (2.5 % chance)…so why not just soft tank…just dont…but then you are hurting your chance to get a top 2nd rd pick and land a potential dropped player

Shitty Bill Winner - Gets an automatic bid to top 5

Non-Playoff team lottery…all 12 teams have an equal chance to be remaining 3 teams in top 5…

So 9 non-playoff teams not in the top 5…will fill out spots 6-14 in the draft (random wheel)

15 playoff teams not in top 5 will finish out draft positions 15-29 (to avoid soft tanking we could do a random wheel for spots 15-24…picks 25-29 will automatically be awarded to the top 5 seeds because they earned the right to pick high in 2nd rd)
The playoff team that wins the lottery and drafts in the top 5 cannot have a top 5 pick in the 2nd rd.

This is a proposal and probably has tons of flaws that @GMDS can analyze.  

Irrational Krav
